$comment: Every value the orchestrator uses lives in this file or in an env var it
names. Nothing is baked into orchestrator.mjs. Interpolation supported in

windows.$comment: Node refuses to spawn .cmd/.bat without a shell. followShims resolves the real executable a package-manager shim forwards to; if that fails we go through the comspec with verbatim arguments.

worker.label: Ox Alpha Max
worker.kickoff: Read TASK.md and implement it completely. Follow AGENTS.md. Write real files; do not stub.

execution.$retryComment: Retries exist for the failure that clears on its own - a provider's per-day quota. Backoff doubles from retryBackoffMs and is capped at retryBackoffMaxMs.

paths.$comment: sandboxRoot MUST resolve outside repoRoot; the doctor check enforces it.

$comment: The worker is a stranger. It sees only what the sandbox contains: the
brief, the standards file, and explicitly seeded inputs. Everything is
swept against the denylist first; a hit aborts that task, not the run.

env.$comment: Only these env vars reach the worker process. HOME/USERPROFILE are required for opencode credential lookup.
